_about: Landmark placements for Windward (agent 4, 2026-11-07). Each row puts one look of the landmark kit (src/landmark-assets.js) at a real place. Nothing here is used by the game yet; src/landmark-lab.js and docs/LANDMARKS.md show how it would be placed.

_fields.era: the game eras it stands in: 1703 | 1950 | today (never an era it did not exist in: tested)
_fields.built: the year THIS LOOK began (not necessarily the first construction), or null if undated; until: the year this look ended, or omitted
_fields.replacedBy: the id of the look that stands in the eras this one does not
_fields.heading: compass bearing (0 north, 90 east) the model's +Z side faces: an arm's direction; omitted = the placer turns it to face the water
_fields.place: the island-lore.json key of the place
_fields.source: where the position and the facts come from
_fields.confidence: exact = the record or node gives the position; approx = the place's point, snapped to land by the placer
_fields.factConfidence: high | medium | low: how sure the fact that it stood there is

_scale: Models are 1:1 real metres. The game enlarges landmarks when it places them (cairns x1.8, marks x2.0: world-year-build.js); the factor is LANDMARK_TYPES[type].readScale in the kit, not baked in here.
